title: Alpha Acceptance Gate
objective: Menilai kesiapan Account & Cloud Center untuk v1.3.0-alpha.1 tanpa mengklaim connector yang belum tersertifikasi.

buckets.note: All 10 acceptance_invariants from the product spec are covered by domain contracts. The test verifies each invariant maps to an existing contract file under lib/features/account/domain/.

The standard connector manifest (115.9) declares availability=UNVERIFIED and isConnectable=false for all 32 providers. No live connector certification is claimed. The test verifies the manifest structure and field contracts.
Provider quota adapters (115.17) preserve provider-reported values and explicitly represent unavailable. The test proves that unavailable is explicit (isAvailable=false) and never fabricated as zero.
Provider icon registry (115.8) registers 32 providers with generic fallback for unknown categories. The test verifies the registry contract and fallback behavior.
Visual regression matrix (115.52) verdict is ALL_PASS across 11 cells (1536x1024, 1440, 1180, 900, 600, mobile, themes, 200_percent_scale, long_text, missing_icon, error_states).

Keyboard and screen reader verification (115.48) audits 8 surfaces (tab, card, providerTile, chart, menu, dialog, form, sensitiveAction). The test verifies the audit is complete and surfaces are covered.

Privacy data-flow review (115.50) proves external_transfer=noneLocalOnly (no HTTP/Dio/WebSocket/HttpClient/url_launcher in lib/features/account). Security billing verification (115.54) verdict is ALL_PASS across 8 buckets.

Live billing/checkout is not reachable from this build. billing_contract.status remains PLANNED_NOT_VERIFIED. No payment provider HTTP client exists under lib/features/account. This is an external boundary that cannot be evaluated locally.

The auth_flow regression (commit a5ed3ae, label 'Sign in or connect account' -> '+ Add Another Method') is documented in the ledger. It is a pre-existing regression outside sprint scope, proven identical in clean worktree baseline. Deferred external gates are listed.

deferred_external: Live OAuth token exchange and revocation against a real identity provider.
Live payment-provider redirects, checkout sessions, and PCI certification.
Live identity-provider session inventory and revocation propagation.
Hosted CI, public-trust signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication gates.
